lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Came back and then what'd you do? Honestly. You went over to his house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I went in ta our garage and put the bike away.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And Bryan was in there workin' on his car.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I he, I asked him if he wants any help and he said no, that if he wanted help, he would come in and get me or somethin' so I went in the house and I sat down.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did Bryan hear the screaming too?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No, he had the radio going.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, you went in the house and sat down, and then?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I waited and then I, I watched TV for a little bit and my mom came home.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And she comes home at about what time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She asked me if anybody got the mail. I'm like yeah, I did and watched TV more and he came over and asked if she wanted help.
